findings.summary: No design-system directory exists anywhere in the run. The UJG models 12 Components and 9 Templates with Slots, SlotBindings, and SurfaceRealizations (org.openuji design-system nodes), but none of them have any implementation or colocated story.

No Storybook configuration or story files exist anywhere in the run (no .storybook/, no *.stories.* files), so no artifact is independently inspectable and no interaction story demonstrates modeled composition or schema-exact data binding.

UJG-flavored identifiers leak into the one implementation file that touches presentation: apps/ui/src/app.mjs echoes UJG @type/operation vocabulary directly in API responses (e.g. type: 'composite-state', action: 'confirm-workshop-registration'/'join-workshop-waitlist'), outside any UJG/schema/bindings-manifest context.

No package.json, tsconfig.json, vite config, or React/Storybook/Tailwind dependency exists anywhere in the run, so the mandated design-system stack from the realization profile was never scaffolded, let alone populated.
